finding.title: Adoption accepts awaiting-cost but the next normal judgment step rejects it
evidence: apps/api/src/runtime/project-supervisor-runtime.ts:52 accepts an awaiting-cost signed result and awaiting-cost run status in adopt().
At line 66, adopt-source-verified also accepts awaiting-cost, saves consumedRunId/resultHash and returns without preparing a model intent or inserting supervisor_consumed.

On the following tick the normal running branch on the same line accepts only success/failed/round-limit/timeout/budget-exhausted. awaiting-cost raises TERMINAL_NOT_NORMAL, which pump():63 turns into disabled/blocked.

An owner grant does not by itself supply the missing model decision: command():58 rejects a consumedRunId without decisionId unless resolving a specifically uncertain model intent, which this path never created.

ExecutionRuntime.result():290 accepts awaiting-cost as a real result outcome, and supervisorDispatch():206 treats it as a grant boundary. Thus this is an explicit supported source shape being blocked before its judgment/grant path.
finding.narrowFix: Align the adoption-to-normal-consumption path for the explicitly accepted signed awaiting-cost outcome. Retain incomplete-cost/unknown usage and source hashes, form conservative failure/diagnostic feedback and a bound model decision, then retain the existing continuation authorization boundary. Do not turn awaiting-cost into success or fabricate known/zero usage.
finding.verificationRequired: The already-required real existing-task source-to-judgment-to-next-window acceptance should include this exact source outcome; no additional test or run was performed by this reviewer.
